product_one_liner.value: SiteVue equips manufacturers and other frontline industrial operators with fixed and wearable cameras whose AI video analytics turn production activity into real-time data on productivity, quality, and safety.

pricing_page.notes: The site footer has no pricing link; customers are directed to book a demo or request a quote.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index describes deployment stories and operational advice for manufacturing leaders; it does not show engineering posts about how the product is built.
